subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a public SKILL.md configuration-action contract, and if so should it be `configUrl`/`configButton` or a shared typed action surface with ClawHub/plugin settings?
rationale: The requested behavior is not a broken existing contract; it exposes skill-authored URLs in an authenticated dashboard and sets public metadata semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the product and trust model.

options.title: Design Shared Action Contract
options.body: Add a typed configuration action with explicit URL policy and shared use across Skills, Skill Cards, or ClawHub/plugin settings before implementation.

options.title: Accept Narrow Fields
options.body: Implement `configUrl` and `configButton` as proposed, with validation and docs that constrain supported URL schemes and trust labeling.

options.title: Keep Homepage Only
options.body: Decline a separate configuration action until a concrete ClawHub/plugin settings surface needs it.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Action Contract
recommendation.body: Add a typed configuration action with explicit URL policy and shared use across Skills, Skill Cards, or ClawHub/plugin settings before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skill metadata/docs history and prior homepage resolver history make this the best available owner for the public contract decision.
